title: A House on a Narrow Sound
subtitle: 休息休闲 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 休息休闲（生活与学习·休息与休闲）
meta: 主题语境：休息休闲（生活与学习·休息与休闲）　|　核心词汇：sound　|　正文 312 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sound 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For eleven years I could not sleep in a room with any ① sound in it at all: not a clock, not a tap, not the ② sound of a road two hundred yards away. Then, in 1998, I spent a week in a house on a narrow ③ sound, with the sea on two sides, and slept for nine hours on the first night, and eleven on the second, which I have never done since and have never been able to explain.

It was the first ④ sound sleep I had had since 1987, and I have thought about it ever since. My mother said the sea does not remove ⑤ sound but arranges it — the same sound every time, in the same order — and that this is what a nursery rhyme does, and what nothing else in my life had ever managed, and that the sound of a road can never do it.

She gave me ⑥ sound advice about sleep, which I ignored for thirty-one years and which I now give to my own children, who ignore it in exactly the same way, and who will, I suppose, give it to theirs. My father gave me a ⑦ sound beating once, in 1979, for breaking a window, and I have never forgotten either of them.

We came home ⑧ safe and sound, as my father said after every journey. He died in 2003. By the ⑨ sound of it, as he used to say about everything he had not seen for himself, the house is still standing.

I have not been back. The ⑩ sound I would most like to hear again is not the sea but my mother, in the next room, turning over at three, which I thought for eleven years meant I had failed, and which I now think meant nothing at all, and which I would give eleven years to hear once more.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （某种特定的）声音；声响（the sound of ...）
D. 固定搭配：safe and sound 平安无恙
E. adj. （睡眠）酣畅的；深沉的（a sound sleep）
F. adj. 合理的；明智的；可靠的（sound advice）
G. adj. 彻底的；充分的（a sound beating）
H. 固定搭配：by the sound of it 听上去；照……的说法

items.q: with any sound in it at all
the sound of a road two hundred yards away
a house on a narrow sound
We came home safe and sound
The sound I would most like to hear again

answers.why: sound 意为“声音、声响”，十一年里房间里只要有一点声音我就睡不着。
the sound of ... 意为“……的声音”，指两百码外马路传来的那种声音。
a sound 意为“海峡、海湾”，1998 年我住的那座房子在一条狭窄的海峡边。
a sound sleep 意为“酣畅的一觉”，那是自 1987 年以来我睡得最沉的一觉。
sound 意为“声音”，母亲说海不是消除声音，而是把声音排列起来。
sound advice 意为“明智的、可靠的建议”，她给了我关于睡眠的好建议，我忽略了三十一年。
a sound beating 意为“一顿痛打”，1979 年父亲为打碎窗户狠狠揍了我一顿。
safe and sound 意为“平安无恙”，每次出门回来父亲都这么说。
by the sound of it 意为“听上去、照说”，照说那座房子还立着。
the sound 意为“那个声音”，我最想再听到的不是海，而是母亲在隔壁翻身的声音。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 十一年里，房间里只要有一点声音我就睡不着。（sound）
我最受不了的是两百码外马路的声音。（the sound of）
那是我自 1987 年以来睡得最沉的一觉。（a sound sleep）
她给了我关于睡眠的可靠建议。（sound advice）
我们平安无恙地回到了家。（safe and sound）
听上去，那座房子还立着。（by the sound of it）
answers: For eleven years I could not sleep in a room with any sound in it at all.
The sound of a road two hundred yards away kept me awake.
It was the first sound sleep I had had since 1987.
She gave me sound advice about sleep.
We came home safe and sound.
By the sound of it, the house is still standing.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sound 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: For eleven years I could not sleep in a room with any sound in it at all, not even a clock or a tap.
The sound of a road two hundred yards away was the worst, and then I slept nine hours in a house on a narrow sound.
It was the first sound sleep I had had since 1987, and my mother said the sea arranges sound rather than removing it.
She gave me sound advice about sleep, which I ignored for thirty-one years.
My father gave me a sound beating once, for breaking a window, and always said we came home safe and sound.
By the sound of it the house is still standing, but the sound I would most like to hear again is my mother turning over at three.
